name: local-dev-cockpit-repo
description: Local developer cockpit for restoring project state, commands, logs, git status, ports, and AI context.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @local-dev-cockpit/core build && pnpm --filter @local-dev-cockpit/server build && pnpm --filter @local-dev-cockpit/web build && pnpm --filter local-dev-cockpit build && pnpm --filter @local-dev-cockpit/desktop build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @local-dev-cockpit/core test && pnpm --filter @local-dev-cockpit/server test && pnpm --filter @local-dev-cockpit/web test && pnpm --filter local-dev-cockpit test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @local-dev-cockpit/core build && pnpm --filter @local-dev-cockpit/server build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.release:check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
